summary: MT-032 QRU Design Director™ fully tested (backend + frontend). All 8 pytest cases pass. critical_code_review_comments: design_director.fix_design_issues has a subtle 'last is not None and sc.overall <= last' plateau-break where 'last' is initialized to None and updated after check — first iteration always survives; behavior looks intentional but a comment noting the semantics would help future maintainers.
score/{pid} endpoint writes design_scorecard on every GET which mutates DB on read; consider whether that side effect is desirable for a GET (though it matches the 'always freshest' UX).

rendering_engine.ensure_branded_assets default allow_ai_hero_art=True for regular manufacturing is correct — verified fix_design_issues passes the settings-derived value so the Design Director path stays $0.
